secoes.titulo: Estratégias de leitura, informação explícita e inferência
Vocabulário em contexto, falsos cognatos e expressões
Gramática para interpretar: tempos, modais, condicionais e coesão
Organização discursiva, propósito, tom e figuras de linguagem
Leitura de textos técnicos e administrativos em inglês

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below to answer the question.

"Remote work has reshaped urban economics across major metropolitan areas. While suburban retail districts have experienced an unexpected boom due to residents staying closer to home on weekdays, downtown commercial centers continue to grapple with high office vacancy rates and declining foot traffic."

According to the excerpt, the shift toward remote work has
alternativas: shifted economic activity away from central business areas toward residential outskirts.
eliminated the need for commercial real estate across both urban and suburban zones.
guaranteed permanent financial recovery for downtown retail merchants and offices.
forced municipal governments to ban weekday commuting into metropolitan centers.
reduced the overall purchasing power of workers living in suburban neighborhoods.
questoes.explicacao: O texto afirma que o comércio suburbano cresceu enquanto centros urbanos sofrem com salas vazias e menos pedestres, indicando transferência de atividade econômica. As demais opções extrapolam ao falar em eliminação total de imóveis, recuperação garantida, proibição estatal ou queda de renda.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the passage below.

"Although renewable energy installations reached record capacity last year, grid modernization has lagged behind. Without substantial investment in high-voltage transmission lines and storage facilities, much of the newly generated wind and solar power cannot be efficiently delivered to high-demand industrial hubs."

It can be inferred from the passage that expanding clean energy generation alone is
alternativas: more expensive than upgrading traditional coal-fired power plants.
insufficient to meet industrial energy needs without adequate distribution infrastructure.
discouraged by environmental regulators in heavily industrialized regions.
capable of stabilizing the electrical grid without battery storage systems.
responsible for reducing electricity demand in manufacturing centers.
questoes.explicacao: Infere-se que apenas gerar energia limpa não basta se faltam linhas de transmissão e armazenamento para levá-la aos polos industriais. As outras opções contradizem o texto ou inventam dados sobre custos de carvão, oposição de reguladores, dispensa de baterias ou queda na demanda fabril.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the text below.

"When checking a dense academic article, skilled readers rarely start by reading every word sequentially. Instead, they inspect headings, abstracts, and concluding paragraphs to grasp the overarching thesis before diving into specific methodological details."

The reading strategy described in the text is primarily intended to
alternativas: memorize statistical tables prior to knowing the research topic.
replace the need for reading the methodology section entirely.
identify the main idea quickly before analyzing detailed content.
translate unfamiliar technical terms using external dictionaries.
critique the author's grammatical choices line by line.
questoes.explicacao: A técnica descrita (skimming) visa captar a tese geral observando títulos, resumos e conclusões antes de ler detalhes metodológicos. As demais alternativas erram ao sugerir memorização prévia de tabelas, exclusão total da metodologia, tradução literal ou revisão gramatical minuciosa.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the fragment below.

"Consumer privacy laws enacted in recent years require digital platforms to obtain explicit opt-in consent before tracking browsing habits. Nevertheless, many interfaces employ confusing visual layouts that subtly steer users toward accepting full data collection simply to avoid tedious menu navigation."

According to the fragment, many digital platforms
alternativas: have completely stopped collecting personal browsing information from users.
offer financial rewards to customers who read the entire privacy policy.
refuse to grant access to anyone who agrees to data tracking.
use interface design to nudge users into consenting to data tracking.
simplify their menus so users can easily reject all tracking cookies.
questoes.explicacao: O trecho explicita que plataformas usam leiautes visuais confusos para induzir o usuário a aceitar o rastreamento de dados. As outras opções contradizem o texto ao citar fim da coleta, recompensas financeiras, bloqueio a quem consente ou simplificação para rejeitar cookies.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below.

"Contrary to popular belief, desert ecosystems are far from barren wastelands. Beneath the arid surface lies an intricate network of dormant seeds, burrowing reptiles, and specialized microorganisms waiting for brief seasonal rains to trigger a rapid cycle of reproduction."

The author's statement implies that desert life is
alternativas: incapable of surviving more than a few weeks without daily rainfall.
entirely dependent on human intervention for water conservation.
restricted to large mammals that migrate across sand dunes.
visibly active on the surface throughout the hottest dry months.
adapted to remain hidden and inactive until moisture becomes available.
questoes.explicacao: Deduz-se que a vida no deserto fica latente ou abrigada no subsolo aguardando chuvas sazonais para se reproduzir. As demais alternativas distorcem o texto ao exigir chuva diária, intervenção humana, limitar a fauna a grandes mamíferos ou afirmar atividade visível na seca.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the short notice below.

"All fellowship applicants must submit two academic references and a research proposal by October 15. Late submissions will not be reviewed, regardless of postal delays or technical glitches on the applicant's side."

When applying a scanning strategy to find the deadline condition, a reader learns that
alternativas: missing the October 15 cutoff results in automatic disqualification.
applicants may send reference letters separately during November.
technical failures entitle candidates to a forty-eight-hour extension.
only one recommendation letter is mandatory for initial screening.
postal postmarks dated October 16 are accepted without penalty.
questoes.explicacao: Ao buscar informações específicas (scanning), verifica-se que envios após 15 de outubro não serão avaliados sob nenhuma justificativa. As outras opções contrariam diretamente as regras explícitas sobre prazo improrrogável, falhas técnicas e número de cartas exigidas.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the paragraph below.

"For decades, culinary historians assumed that pasta was brought to Italy from China by Marco Polo in the thirteenth century. Archival records from Sicily, however, document the production of dried wheat noodles by Arab inhabitants more than a century prior to Polo's famous voyage."

Based on the paragraph, historical records from Sicily demonstrate that
alternativas: Marco Polo introduced Sicilian wheat recipes to Chinese emperors.
pasta manufacturing existed in Italy before Marco Polo returned from Asia.
Arab traders prohibited the consumption of wheat noodles in medieval Europe.
dried pasta was invented in China during the fourteenth century.
Italian cuisine avoided grain products until the late Renaissance.
questoes.explicacao: Os registros sicilianos provam que massas secas de trigo já eram produzidas na região mais de um século antes da viagem de Marco Polo. As demais opções invertem a cronologia ou inventam proibições árabes, datas incorretas e rejeição a grãos até o Renascimento.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below.

"Automated translation tools have achieved remarkable fluency in everyday correspondence, yet diplomatic negotiations still rely heavily on human interpreters. A single misjudged nuance or cultural idiom in a bilateral treaty can inadvertently escalate geopolitical tensions."

From the excerpt, one can conclude that human interpreters remain essential in diplomacy because they
alternativas: work faster and at a lower cost than modern software programs.
Eliminate the need for written treaties between sovereign nations.
possess sensitivity to subtle meanings and cultural context that machines may miss.
refuse to use standard vocabulary when drafting international agreements.
are legally authorized to alter foreign policy decisions during summits.
questoes.explicacao: Conclui-se que intérpretes humanos são cruciais na diplomacia por captarem nuances e expressões culturais que máquinas podem falhar em perceber. As outras opções erram ao atribuir-lhes menor custo, abolição de tratados escritos, rejeição ao vocabulário padrão ou poder decisório político.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the sentence below.

"Although the pharmaceutical company claimed the new ointment was completely benign, several patients reported severe skin irritation within hours of application."

In the context of the sentence, the word "benign" is closest in meaning to
alternativas: expensive.
contagious.
effective.
harmless.
experimental.
questoes.explicacao: O contraste introduzido por 'Although' entre a alegação da empresa e a grave irritação cutânea mostra que 'benign' significa inofensivo ('harmless'). As demais palavras (caro, contagioso, eficaz ou experimental) não estabelecem a oposição lógica exigida pelo contexto clínico.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below.

"During the parliamentary inquiry, the minister tried to gloss over the budget deficit by highlighting minor reductions in administrative travel expenses."

The phrasal verb "gloss over" in the excerpt means to
alternativas: investigate thoroughly with independent auditors.
confess openly to the general public.
calculate with extreme mathematical precision.
celebrate as a major economic triumph.
conceal or minimize the seriousness of a flaw.
questoes.explicacao: A expressão 'gloss over' significa disfarçar ou minimizar um problema (o déficit orçamentário) desviando o foco para cortes pequenos. As outras alternativas propõem sentidos opostos ou desconexos, como investigar a fundo, confessar abertamente, calcular com precisão ou celebrar.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the statement below.

"The investigative journalist attended the press conference intending to expose the fabrication of environmental compliance reports by the mining corporation."

For a Portuguese-speaking reader, the word "fabrication" in this context acts as a false friend because it actually refers to
alternativas: an invention of false information in order to deceive.
the industrial assembly of heavy mining machinery.
a legal authorization granted by state authorities.
the physical construction of a corporate headquarters.
an annual summary of verified ecological achievements.
questoes.explicacao: Em contextos investigativos e documentais, 'fabrication' é um falso cognato quando confundido com manufatura física, significando adulteração ou invenção de dados falsos. As demais opções caem na armadilha da tradução literal fabril ou inventam sentidos de autorização e resumo.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the passage below.

"After three failed rounds of mediation, the labor union decided to call it a day and resume negotiations the following week when both parties were less exhausted."

The idiomatic expression "call it a day" indicates that the participants decided to
alternativas: sign a permanent collective bargaining agreement immediately.
stop working on the negotiation for the remainder of that day.
organize an indefinite nationwide strike starting at midnight.
replace all union representatives with external legal advisors.
extend the meeting through the night until a consensus emerged.
questoes.explicacao: O idioma 'call it a day' significa encerrar as atividades do dia, confirmado pelo fato de retomarem as negociações na semana seguinte por exaustão. As outras opções erram ao sugerir assinatura imediata, greve geral, troca de representantes ou virar a noite reunidos.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the sentence below.

"Because the witness gave a comprehensive account of the accident, the traffic investigators were able to reconstruct the sequence of events without further interviews."

In the sentence above, the word "comprehensive" means
alternativas: easy to forgive and emotionally sympathetic.
brief and restricted to personal opinions.
thorough and including all relevant details.
confusing and full of contradictory statements.
translated from a foreign language by an amateur.
questoes.explicacao: 'Comprehensive' é um clássico falso cognato em provas: significa abrangente, completo ('thorough'), razão pela qual os investigadores dispensaram novas entrevistas. Não significa compreensivo/empático (que seria 'understanding'), nem breve, confuso ou traduzido.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below.

"Small agricultural producers often bear the brunt of sudden export tariffs, as they lack the financial reserves that allow multinational agribusinesses to absorb temporary losses."

To "bear the brunt of" something means to
alternativas: reap the highest financial profits from a regulatory change.
evade government taxes through offshore banking accounts.
initiate a legal dispute in international trade courts.
suffer the worst part or main impact of an unpleasant event.
predict market fluctuations using historical weather data.
questoes.explicacao: A expressão 'bear the brunt of' significa suportar o impacto principal ou sofrer a pior parte de algo negativo (tarifas de exportação), pois pequenos produtores não têm reservas financeiras. As outras opções falam em lucrar, sonegar impostos, processar ou prever oscilações.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the text below.

"While initial clinical trials yielded promising outcomes, senior epidemiologists remain circumspect about declaring the vaccine fully effective until larger population data are analyzed."

The adjective "circumspect" could be replaced, without change in meaning, by
alternativas: enthusiastic.
reckless.
indifferent.
arrogant.
cautious.
questoes.explicacao: O contraste com resultados iniciais promissores e a espera por dados maiores mostram que 'circumspect' significa cauteloso, prudente ('cautious'). As demais opções (entusiasmado, imprudente, indiferente ou arrogante) contradizem a postura científica cuidadosa descrita.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the sentence below.

"The municipality's decision to axe public library funding sparked widespread protests among educators and neighborhood associations."

In journalistic English, the verb "axe" in this context means to
alternativas: drastically cut or eliminate.
double the financial allocation for.
transfer management to teachers.
audit for accounting irregularities.
postpone until the next fiscal year.
questoes.explicacao: No jargão jornalístico, o verbo 'to axe' associado a verbas ou cargos significa cortar drasticamente ou eliminar, o que explica os protestos de educadores. As demais opções (dobrar verba, transferir gestão, auditar ou adiar) não condizem com o significado nem com a reação gerada.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the sentence below.

"Had the central bank raised interest rates six months earlier, inflationary pressures would not have eroded household savings so severely."

The grammatical structure used in the sentence expresses a
alternativas: future prediction based on current economic stability.
past hypothetical condition whose outcome cannot be changed.
routine monetary policy executed every six months.
direct order issued by household savers to banking authorities.
present certainty that inflation is no longer affecting consumers.
questoes.explicacao: A inversão 'Had the central bank raised...' equivale a 'If it had raised...' (Third Conditional), expressando uma hipótese irreal no passado (o banco não subiu os juros e a inflação corroeu a poupança). As outras opções confundem com previsão futura, rotina, ordem ou certeza presente.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the passage below.

"Researchers have been monitoring the glacier's retreat since the late 1990s, documenting a steady acceleration in ice loss over the past decade."

The verb tense "have been monitoring" is used to emphasize an action that
alternativas: was completed before the late 1990s and never repeated.
will begin only after the glacier completely disappears.
started in the past and continues into the present.
happened at an unspecified moment without ongoing relevance.
occurred once during a single winter expedition.
questoes.explicacao: O Present Perfect Continuous ('have been monitoring') aliado a 'since the late 1990s' indica uma ação iniciada no passado e que continua em andamento no presente. As demais opções descrevem ações encerradas no passado remoto, futuras, pontuais ou sem continuidade.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below.

"Given that the encrypted server logs were accessed using the chief accountant's credentials at 2:00 a.m., the breach must have been carried out by someone familiar with internal security protocols."

In the excerpt, the modal structure "must have been carried out" conveys
alternativas: a formal obligation imposed on future security employees.
an absolute prohibition against late-night server maintenance.
a polite request for the accountant to change his password.
a strong logical deduction about a past event based on evidence.
a regret that the security protocols failed to work properly.
questoes.explicacao: A estrutura 'must have + particípio passado' expressa dedução lógica forte ou quase certeza sobre um fato passado com base nas evidências apresentadas. Não expressa obrigação futura, proibição, pedido educado nem arrependimento (que usaria 'should have').

questoes.enunciado:
Read the paragraph below.

"Urban green spaces significantly reduce the heat-island effect in densely populated districts. Furthermore, they provide residents with accessible areas for physical exercise, which correlates with lower rates of cardiovascular disease."

The cohesive device "Furthermore" could be accurately replaced by
alternativas: Nevertheless,
Conversely,
Otherwise,
Instead,
Moreover,
questoes.explicacao: 'Furthermore' é um conectivo aditivo (além disso), somando um novo benefício das áreas verdes ao argumento anterior; portanto, equivale a 'Moreover'. As demais opções indicam concessão/contraste ('Nevertheless', 'Conversely'), condição negativa ('Otherwise') ou substituição ('Instead').

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below.

"When biodegradable plastics are disposed of in conventional landfills rather than industrial composting facilities, they decompose very slowly; their environmental impact, therefore, remains higher than consumers expect."

The possessive adjective "their" in the second clause refers back to
alternativas: biodegradable plastics.
conventional landfills.
industrial composting facilities.
consumers.
municipal waste collectors.
questoes.explicacao: Pela coesão referencial e sentido lógico, 'their environmental impact' retoma 'biodegradable plastics' (sujeito da oração anterior por meio de 'they'), cujo impacto ambiental permanece alto quando descartados incorretamente. As outras opções não fazem sentido como possuidoras desse impacto inesperado.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the sentence below.

"Public agencies should have updated their legacy software before the support contract expired, as patching vulnerabilities now requires costly emergency consultants."

By using "should have updated", the author indicates that the software update
alternativas: was successfully completed ahead of schedule.
was advisable in the past, but was not actually done.
is strictly forbidden under the current support contract.
will automatically occur without hiring external consultants.
might be unnecessary because legacy systems never fail.
questoes.explicacao: O modal perfeito 'should have + particípio' indica crítica ou arrependimento quanto a algo recomendável no passado que não foi realizado (as agências não atualizaram o software a tempo). As demais opções contradizem o fato de que agora precisam contratar consultores caros de emergência.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the sentence below.

"The municipality will release the second installment of the infrastructure grant provided that the contractor submits an audited environmental impact report."

The conjunction "provided that" introduces a relationship of
alternativas: concession.
chronological sequence.
condition.
comparison.
unintended consequence.
questoes.explicacao: A locução conjuntiva 'provided that' equivale a 'contanto que' ou 'desde que', estabelecendo uma condição indispensável para a liberação da parcela do recurso. Não expressa concessão, sequência meramente temporal, comparação nem consequência involuntária.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the passage below.

"By the time the rescue vessel reached the remote archipelago, the meteorological station staff had already evacuated the coastal compound and moved to higher ground."

The use of the Past Perfect ("had already evacuated") signals that the evacuation took place
alternativas: simultaneously with the arrival of the rescue vessel.
several days after the rescue crew landed on the island.
only because the naval officers ordered it upon arrival.
prior to the moment the rescue vessel arrived at the archipelago.
repeatedly every summer during the tourist season.
questoes.explicacao: O Past Perfect ('had evacuated') marca uma ação passada ocorrida antes de outra ação também no passado ('reached'). Logo, a equipe evacuou a base antes da chegada do navio de resgate, e não simultaneamente, depois, por ordem presencial da tripulação ou como rotina anual.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the passage below.

"Oh, sure, cutting the city's public transit budget by thirty percent while adding one extra lane to the downtown highway will magically dissolve morning gridlock—just as it has failed to do in every major metropolis over the last fifty years."

The tone adopted by the author in this passage is best described as
alternativas: reverent and complimentary.
neutral and purely statistical.
nostalgic and sentimental.
apologetic and hesitant.
ironic and critical.
questoes.explicacao: O uso de 'Oh, sure' e 'magically dissolve' seguido pela constatação de que a medida falhou nos últimos cinquenta anos revela um tom irônico/sarcástico e crítico à decisão urbana. As demais opções (reverente, neutro, nostálgico ou hesitante) ignoram a ironia explícita.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below.

"For years, oceanic plastic pollution was treated as an aesthetic nuisance along tourist beaches. Today, however, toxicology studies reveal that microplastics have infiltrated the marine food web, becoming a silent time bomb sitting on our dinner plates."

In the final clause, comparing microplastics to "a silent time bomb" is a figure of speech (metaphor) used to emphasize
alternativas: a hidden and accumulating threat to human health through food consumption.
the use of naval explosives to clear debris from commercial shipping lanes.
the exact hour of the day when restaurants serve contaminated seafood.
a decrease in the noise levels of industrial fishing vessels at sea.
the immediate visual beauty of plastic fragments washed ashore.
questoes.explicacao: A metáfora 'silent time bomb sitting on our dinner plates' enfatiza um perigo oculto e cumulativo à saúde humana pela ingestão de alimentos contaminados. As outras alternativas fazem leituras literais absurdas sobre explosivos navais, horários de jantar, ruído de barcos ou beleza visual.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the text below.

"Early writing systems, such as Mesopotamian cuneiform, emerged primarily as accounting tools to record grain tributes and livestock inventories. Over centuries, these rigid administrative symbols evolved into flexible phonetic scripts capable of capturing epic poetry, legal codes, and philosophical treatises."

How is the discourse organized in the text above?
alternativas: It presents a modern scientific problem and proposes three competing solutions.
It traces a historical progression from a practical origin to broader cultural uses.
It refutes an archaeological theory by attacking the credibility of historians.
It compares the grammatical rules of two modern European languages.
It lists step-by-step instructions on how to carve clay tablets today.
questoes.explicacao: O texto organiza-se cronologicamente mostrando a evolução histórica da escrita desde sua origem contábil prática até usos culturais amplos (poesia, leis, filosofia). As outras opções erram ao falar em soluções científicas atuais, ataque a historiadores, línguas modernas ou manual prático.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the paragraph below.

"Before purchasing a home water filtration pitcher, consumers should verify which contaminants are prevalent in their local supply. Activated carbon filters effectively remove chlorine taste and odor, whereas reverse osmosis units are required to eliminate dissolved heavy metals and fluoride."

The primary communicative purpose of this paragraph is to
alternativas: campaign for the privatization of municipal water treatment plants.
narrate a personal anecdote about a family suffering from dehydration.
inform readers about functional differences between filtration methods to guide choice.
frighten citizens into boycotting all tap water across the country.
advertise a specific brand of bottled mineral water sold in supermarkets.
questoes.explicacao: O propósito comunicativo é informar objetivamente sobre as diferenças de eficácia entre filtros de carvão ativado e osmose reversa para orientar a compra do consumidor. Não há campanha de privatização, relato pessoal, terrorismo contra água encanada nem propaganda de marca.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below.

"When the speculative housing bubble finally burst in 2008, the shockwaves didn't just topple Wall Street investment banks; they swept across the Atlantic, freezing credit markets and shuttering factories from Dublin to Tokyo."

The figurative expressions "shockwaves", "topple", and "swept across" are employed by the writer to convey the idea of
alternativas: a localized natural earthquake that destroyed physical buildings in New York.
a peaceful transition from manufacturing to agricultural employment.
an intentional celebration organized by international central bankers.
a powerful, fast-spreading destructive force affecting the global economy.
a slow and imperceptible adjustment in residential architectural styles.
questoes.explicacao: As metáforas de ondas de choque que derrubam ('topple') e varrem oceanos ('swept across') ilustram a força destrutiva e o rápido contágio global da crise financeira de 2008. As demais opções interpretam literalmente como terremoto físico ou contradizem a gravidade do evento.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the two-sentence passage below.

"Proponents of algorithmic sentencing argue that software removes human bias from judicial decisions. Yet, because these algorithms are trained on historical arrest records that reflect decades of unequal policing, they merely launder past prejudices through a veneer of mathematical objectivity."

In the second sentence, the author's argumentative strategy consists of
alternativas: endorsing the proponents' view by providing additional statistical proof.
changing the subject to discuss the salary of courtroom stenographers.
admitting that mathematical models have completely eradicated systemic bias.
postponing any judgment until artificial intelligence replaces all lawyers.
countering the initial claim by exposing a flaw in the data used by the system.
questoes.explicacao: Na segunda frase, introduzida por 'Yet', o autor refuta o argumento favorável aos algoritmos mostrando que os dados históricos de treinamento já contêm vieses e apenas os mascaram. As outras opções dizem que ele concorda, muda de assunto, admite erradicação do viés ou adia o juízo.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt below.

"As the drought entered its fourth consecutive year, the parched valley begged for a single drop of rain, its cracked clay soil yawning beneath a relentless brass sky."

Describing the valley as having "begged" and the soil as "yawning" is an example of
alternativas: personification, attributing human actions to inanimate natural elements.
understatement, minimizing the severity of the agricultural crisis.
euphemism, softening harsh news about excessive winter flooding.
oxymoron, combining two contradictory technical terms in one noun phrase.
paradox, proving that desert climates contain more water than rainforests.
questoes.explicacao: Atribuir ações humanas como implorar ('begged') e bocejar ('yawning') ao vale e ao solo seco caracteriza personificação (prosopopeia) para intensificar a descrição da seca. Não se trata de eufemismo, atenuação ('understatement'), oximoro nem paradoxo climático.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the passage below.

"While standard GDP metrics capture the monetary value of goods and services produced within a nation, they remain blind to unpaid domestic labor, environmental depletion, and income inequality. Consequently, economists increasingly advocate supplementary indicators to assess genuine societal well-being."

How does the second sentence relate to the first in the organization of the passage?
alternativas: It contradicts the claim that GDP measures goods and services.
It presents a logical consequence derived from the limitations outlined in the first sentence.
It provides a historical biography of the economist who invented GDP.
It illustrates an example of how environmental depletion boosts national wealth.
It dismisses all economic indicators as useless for public policy.
questoes.explicacao: Introduzida por 'Consequently', a segunda frase apresenta o resultado lógico das limitações do PIB apontadas na primeira: a defesa de indicadores complementares de bem-estar. As demais opções falam em contradição, biografia histórica, elogio à degradação ou descarte total de índices.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the internal memorandum below.

"MEMORANDUM
TO: All Department Heads
FROM: Chief Information Security Officer
SUBJECT: Mandatory Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) Rollout

Effective November 1, legacy single-password access to the enterprise cloud portal will be decommissioned. Staff members who fail to enroll a secondary verification device by October 28 will have their remote credentials temporarily suspended until compliance is verified by the Help Desk."

According to the memorandum, employees who do not register a secondary device by October 28 will
alternativas: be permanently terminated from their positions at the company.
continue using their single password until the end of the calendar year.
lose remote access temporarily until they complete the security requirement.
receive a new company laptop pre-configured by their Department Head.
be fined by the Help Desk for violating intellectual property laws.
questoes.explicacao: O memorando administrativo informa que quem não cadastrar o segundo fator até 28 de outubro terá as credenciais remotas suspensas temporariamente até regularizar a situação no suporte. As demais opções inventam demissão, prorrogação de senha única, entrega de laptop ou multa.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the procurement clause below.

"4.2 Liquidated Damages: In the event the Supplier fails to deliver the server racks by the agreed milestone date, the Contracting Authority shall deduct 0.5% of the total contract value per calendar day of delay, capped at 10% of the aggregate price, without prejudice to its right to terminate for material breach."

Based on clause 4.2, if the Supplier delays delivery, the Contracting Authority is entitled to
alternativas: withhold up to the entire contract value as a daily penalty.
extend the delivery deadline automatically without financial deductions.
demand that the Supplier pay an additional 50% bonus to the Authority.
apply daily financial deductions up to a 10% limit and still retain the right to cancel the contract.
waive all contractual rights once the delay exceeds twenty calendar days.
questoes.explicacao: A cláusula prevê multa diária de 0,5% por atraso, limitada a 10% do valor total ('capped at 10%'), sem prejuízo ('without prejudice') do direito de rescindir o contrato por infração grave. As outras opções erram nos percentuais, falam em isenção automática ou renúncia de direitos.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the technical release note below.

"Patch v3.4.1 addresses a memory leak in the database indexing service that caused intermittent CPU spikes during nightly batch processing. Administrators do not need to reboot the host server after applying the patch, though restarting the indexing daemon is required for changes to take effect."

To ensure that Patch v3.4.1 works properly after installation, the system administrator must
alternativas: shut down and restart the entire physical host server immediately.
schedule nightly batch processing to run only once a month.
uninstall the database software and format the storage drives.
upgrade the server's physical CPU hardware before running the patch.
restart the specific indexing service without needing to reboot the whole server.
questoes.explicacao: A nota técnica explicita que não é preciso reiniciar o servidor inteiro ('host server'), mas é obrigatório reiniciar o serviço de indexação ('indexing daemon') para aplicar a correção. As demais opções contradizem a instrução de reboot ou inventam formatação e troca de hardware.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the excerpt from an audit report below.

"Our sample audit of third-quarter travel reimbursements revealed a lack of segregation of duties within the regional branch: seven expense claims exceeding $5,000 were both submitted and approved by the same operational manager, contravening Section 9 of the Internal Control Charter."

What administrative irregularity did the auditors identify?
alternativas: A single manager authorized his or her own high-value expense claims instead of having an independent approval.
The regional branch refused to reimburse employees for legitimate business travel during the third quarter.
Seven operational managers collaborated to forge the signature of the Chief Executive Officer.
Expense claims below $5,000 were audited by external tax authorities without prior notice.
Section 9 of the Internal Control Charter had been repealed before the third quarter began.
questoes.explicacao: A falha de segregação de funções apontada na auditoria ocorreu porque o mesmo gerente submeteu e aprovou sete pedidos de reembolso acima de cinco mil dólares. As outras opções distorcem o relato ao falar em recusa de reembolso, falsificação de assinatura do CEO ou revogação da norma.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the service level agreement (SLA) excerpt below.

"Scheduled Maintenance Windows: The Cloud Provider reserves the right to perform routine system maintenance on Sundays between 01:00 and 05:00 UTC, provided at least 72 hours' prior electronic notice is given to the Client. Downtime occurring within properly notified windows shall be excluded from monthly uptime percentage calculations."

According to the SLA excerpt, downtime during a Sunday maintenance window will NOT count against the monthly uptime guarantee if the Cloud Provider
alternativas: completes the maintenance on a Tuesday afternoon instead of Sunday.
sends an electronic notification to the Client at least three days in advance.
pays a financial rebate to the Client prior to shutting down the servers.
allows the Client's engineers to rewrite the cloud source code.
keeps the maintenance window longer than twelve consecutive hours.
questoes.explicacao: A indisponibilidade na janela de domingo fica excluída do cálculo mensal de disponibilidade desde que o provedor envie aviso eletrônico prévio de no mínimo 72 horas (três dias). As demais opções alteram o dia, inventam reembolso prévio, acesso ao código-fonte ou janelas de 12 horas.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the human resources policy excerpt below.

"Conflict of Interest Disclosure: Employees must promptly disclose via the Ethics Portal any financial interest held by themselves or immediate family members in outside vendors bidding on agency contracts. Disclosure does not automatically disqualify the vendor, but requires the employee's recusal from the evaluation committee."

Under this policy, when an employee reports that a close relative owns shares in a bidding vendor, the agency requires that the
alternativas: vendor be permanently banned from competing for any public contract.
family member sell all company shares within twenty-four hours.
employee step aside and not participate in judging that bid.
Ethics Portal be shut down until the procurement process concludes.
employee be promoted to chair the contract evaluation committee.
questoes.explicacao: A política esclarece que a declaração não desqualifica automaticamente o fornecedor, mas exige o impedimento/afastamento ('recusal') do servidor da comissão avaliadora. As outras opções erram ao falar em banimento do fornecedor, venda de ações em 24h, fechamento do portal ou promoção.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the executive summary below.

"Q4 Supply Chain Review: Consolidating warehouse operations from four regional depots into two automated hubs reduced annual overhead by 14%. However, average last-mile delivery lead times to rural customers increased from 48 to 72 hours, prompting a review of third-party courier partnerships."

The executive summary indicates that the warehouse consolidation resulted in
alternativas: a 14% increase in operational expenses across all four regional depots.
faster delivery times for customers located in remote rural areas.
the complete elimination of automated technology in logistics hubs.
cost savings in overhead accompanied by slower deliveries to rural areas.
the immediate termination of all urban retail sales during the fourth quarter.
questoes.explicacao: O resumo mostra um efeito duplo: redução de 14% nos custos fixos ('overhead') por um lado, mas aumento no tempo de entrega rural de 48 para 72 horas por outro. As demais opções invertem esses dados ao citar aumento de custos, entregas rurais mais rápidas, fim da automação ou fim de vendas.

questoes.enunciado:
Read the technical specification below.

"Data Retention & Purge Protocol: Transaction logs containing personally identifiable information (PII) must be stored in an encrypted repository for 90 days for fraud-auditing purposes. Upon expiration of the 90-day period, an automated script shall anonymize user identifiers before transferring the records to cold archival storage."

According to the protocol, what happens to transaction logs after 90 days?
alternativas: They are published on the company's public website for transparency.
They remain in the active repository with full personal details indefinitely.
They are permanently deleted without keeping any statistical archive.
They are printed on paper and mailed to the respective customers.
Personal identifiers are stripped out before the logs are moved to long-term archive.
questoes.explicacao: Após 90 dias, um script automatizado anonimiza os identificadores pessoais antes de transferir os registros para armazenamento de arquivo frio (longo prazo). As outras opções contrariam o protocolo ao citar publicação na web, manutenção indefinida de dados pessoais, exclusão total ou impressão.
